title: Invested amount drifted with trading PnL
symptoms: invested figure changed with no transfer
per-account invested differed from the transfer ledger
fleet total invested moved daily
root_cause: invested_usd was derived as wallet minus cumulative PnL, so every trade moved it. The transfer ledger already existed but the helper that was supposed to read it did not exist in listener.py.
fix: invested_usd now comes from /var/lib/hypercopy-copy/invest_exact.json (built by invest_sync.py from real transfers) in both copy engines and the fleet snapshot.
verify: sampled /status/all twice 100 seconds apart with live fills between: identical figures, total 2500.50

title: Retained position kept its mirror record, showing a permanent Mirroring label
symptoms: position labelled Mirroring days after the source closed it
app warns retained long has no separate live position
source-lost sweep never fires
root_cause: The retention path wrote a retained record but left the original entry in state['mirrored']. The source-lost sweep deliberately skips keys already in retained_trailing, so the ghost was exempt from every reconciliation.
fix: On retention, the mirror record and its source_missing counter are removed, so the position is reported as retained/owner-managed only.
verify: johndrockefeller BTC long confirmed in the source closed book via fetch_source_book; after fix /status shows 0 retained, 8 mirrors, 0 errors

title: Owner-managed labels used the Bybit symbol form and were pruned, causing false warnings
symptoms: app reports owner-managed HBAR long has no live position while the position is open
audit protections disappear within one poll
root_cause: Labels were stored as HBARUSDT/long by the audit writers, while every comparison built pairs from tickers (HBAR/long). The mismatch both pruned the protection and produced false warnings in the app.
fix: Manual labels are normalised (trailing USDT stripped, side lowercased) before comparison, so both forms match.
verify: manual_add HBAR/long and STRK/long persisted across a full poll cycle and the app warnings cleared

title: App to VPS calls rejected with 403 bad signature
symptoms: Repair request failed: VM returned 403
button works from a terminal but not from the app
root_cause: The app carried its own shared value that matched neither the listener secret nor any copy-engine env. The listener compared against a single secret.
fix: The listener accepts any fleet-level secret (listener plus /etc/copy-*.env), allowlists the app value by SHA-256 fingerprint, and logs a masked fingerprint on every rejection so a new client is identifiable without exposing secrets.
verify: app function returned 200 for both scan and fix; a junk signature still returns 403

title: Frontend called a non-existent Base44 function named selfcheck/fix
symptoms: 404 Backend function 'selfcheck/fix' not found or not deployed
Repair summary shows a red error
root_cause: selfcheck/fix is a VPS REST path, not a Base44 function. The button invoked it as a platform function.
fix: The page calls the deployed function (repairFleetStatus / scanFleetStatus) or now the VPS directly from the browser.
verify: invoke('scanFleetStatus') returns 200 with a real report

title: Source rename made an entire source book unreadable
symptoms: source profile not findable on Involio
Wrong source owner error in the watchdog
book frozen at its last good snapshot
root_cause: Ownership was validated by username or by a cached owner id, but the cache held no entry for that portfolio, so a rename looked identical to a stranger taking the portfolio over.
fix: The owner cache now stores the portfolio's immutable identity (created date plus title). A username change is adopted and logged when that identity matches; a transferred portfolio is still refused. Rename events go to source_renames.log.
verify: booobsas resolved to inquisitor, book returned 3 open positions, engine resumed copying XRP and SOL

title: Source lost for hours with no policy for the trades
symptoms: mirrors keep pointing at a source nobody can read
positions sit unmanaged when a profile disappears
root_cause: There was no rule for a permanently unreadable source: the self-poll simply skipped it and the stale book was merged forward.
fix: Source health is tracked inside the existing 60 second poll. A profile unreachable for 6 hours is marked lost and its mirrors are parked as owner-managed with a take-profit; a recovery clears the flag automatically.
verify: watchdog folded into the poll; health file reports all five profiles ok; /source/lost returns 400 for unknown profiles and parks real ones

title: Bybit 10006 rate limit from the 2 second risk loop
symptoms: retCode 10006 on position queries
mirroring stalls while trailing is active
root_cause: The 2 second risk loop called position/list every tick while retained trailing positions existed, exceeding the per-UID limit.
fix: Cache the open-mirror set for 10 seconds and pause for 60 seconds on a 10006 response; exchange stops stay in place.
verify: zero 10006 events after restart with retained positions active

title: Bybit 10001 when setting SL/TP right after a close
symptoms: 10001 on trading-stop after a position closed
retained trailing fails to place its trigger
root_cause: Race between the close fill and the immediate protective order on a position that no longer existed.
fix: Retry and confirm the position is still open before placing protective orders; treat 10001 as a benign skip when the position is flat.
verify: no 10001 in the log after retained closes

title: Bybit 10002 timestamp errors from VM clock drift
symptoms: retCode 10002 recv_window
every signed call fails at once
root_cause: Local clock drifted beyond the 15 second receive window.
fix: Keep NTP synchronisation tight on the VM and check clock offset before blaming credentials.
verify: offset within 1 second and signed calls succeed

title: Deterministic broker IDs collided between distinct mirrors
symptoms: duplicate orderLinkId rejected
one mirror never opens
root_cause: Order link ids were derived from the mirror key alone, so two trades produced the same id.
fix: Generate a unique broker id per order event.
verify: no duplicate id rejections in the log

title: Involio API domain migration broke every fetch
symptoms: all source snapshots unavailable
HTTPError on every profile
root_cause: The API moved from api.involio.com to api.invoapp.com.
fix: Base URL switched with an automatic failover between known hosts on transport-level failures.
verify: all profiles fetch successfully after the switch

title: Dashboard refresh burned integration credits through a backend function
symptoms: thousands of integration credits per day
credit use far above the trading activity
root_cause: Every page load and every 45 second auto-refresh invoked a Base44 backend function that proxied to the VPS.
fix: The listener enables CORS and accepts the app token for read and bookkeeping endpoints, so the browser calls the VPS directly; the backend functions remain only as a fallback. Entity writes were removed from the refresh path.
verify: CORS preflight returns allow-origin * and x-signature; status/all answers in 12ms

title: Alert workflow firing on a dry-run bot's event stream
symptoms: entity triggered workflow runs every few minutes
alerts for trades that were never placed
root_cause: Binance Bot Alerts triggered on every BinanceBotEvent create, and the bot is still in DRY_RUN, so it produced hundreds of simulation events.
fix: Workflow deactivated until the bot trades live; the event stream alone should never trigger alerts for dry-run records.

title: Python import order broke listener startup after an automated patch
symptoms: service stuck activating
SyntaxError: from __future__ imports must occur at the beginning of the file
root_cause: An automated edit prepended an import above from __future__.
fix: New imports are placed after the future import; every patch now runs ast.parse before the service is restarted.

title: Multi-line expression mangled by a line-based automated edit
symptoms: SyntaxError after replacing a value that spanned two lines
listener returns 500
root_cause: A patch replaced one line of a two-line expression, leaving a dangling continuation.
fix: Reverted from git and reapplied with a regex over the whole file; syntax is validated before commit, and the commit is only pushed when the check passes.
